name: Mission Strawberry Margarita (ready to pour)
method: Chill the bottle and pour a 90 ml serving into a glass. Ice and a rim are optional; no additional spirits or juice are needed.
note: Source checked 2026-11-16. One-item serving suggestion by BarBuddy, not a scratch-made recipe. Bottle is 25% ABV; 90 ml is a suggested pour, not the whole bottle. Do not pour this undiluted high-alcohol premix into the SLUSHi.

name: Mission Tamarind Margarita (ready to pour)
method: Chill the bottle and pour a 90 ml serving into a glass. Ice and a rim are optional; no additional spirits or juice are needed.
note: Source checked 2026-11-16. One-item serving suggestion by BarBuddy, not a scratch-made recipe. Bottle is 25% ABV; 90 ml is a suggested pour, not the whole bottle. Do not pour this undiluted high-alcohol premix into the SLUSHi.

name: Ninja SLUSHi Margarita (lime-juice version)
method: Combine the liquids, using the lime juice, 1 cup syrup and 2 cups water as the source’s limeade substitute; the remaining ¼ cup syrup and 1 cup water complete the batch. Chill, load the vessel and select SPIKED SLUSH. Dispense when ready. Do not add ice or solids.
note: Source checked 2026-11-16. Six servings, 7¼ US cups total (about 1.72 L). Uses the author’s published limeade substitution, retaining the extra syrup and water in the recipe. Standard 1:1 syrup; richer syrups need adjustment. Scale all ingredients together to your model’s fill lines. Flavor and freezing depend on brand sugar/ABV; follow the model guide. Garnish optional.

name: Ninja SLUSHi Pineapple Rum
method: Combine chilled liquids, pour into the vessel and select SPIKED SLUSH. The FS301 source sets 10 temperature bars; use your model’s corresponding texture guidance and dispense when ready. Add no ice or solids.
sourceLabel: Ninja Test Kitchen · Pineapple Rum Slushi
note: Source checked 2026-11-16. 2–3 servings, 3 US cups total. Spiced rum and canned full-fat coconut milk are required; coconut cream and cream of coconut are different products. Tested source model FS301; check your model’s fill limits.

name: Ninja SLUSHi Frozen Mimosa
method: Pour chilled orange juice and sparkling wine into the vessel. Select SPIKED SLUSH, adjust texture if desired and dispense when ready. Add no ice or solids.
sourceLabel: Ninja Test Kitchen · Frozen Mimosa Slushi
note: Source checked 2026-11-16. 2–3 servings, 3 US cups total. The source permits Prosecco, Champagne, Cava or sparkling wine. Still white wine is not a substitute. Tested source model FS301; check your model’s fill limits.

name: Ninja SLUSHi Coffee Frappé
method: Dissolve sugar in the coffee and combine with half-and-half and vanilla. Cool completely before loading. Select FRAPPÉ and dispense when ready, within 30 minutes after the preset ends. Add no ice.
sourceLabel: Ninja Test Kitchen · Coffee Frappé Slushi
note: Source checked 2026-11-16. 2–3 servings. Source liquid base is 3 US cups plus dissolved sugar and vanilla. Half-and-half, vanilla and sugar are required; toppings optional. Tested source model FS301; check your model’s fill limits.

name: Ninja SLUSHi Diet Cola Slush
method: Mix chilled prepared diet cola with liquid allulose and lemon juice; pour into the vessel. Select SLUSH and set temperature to 2 bars as directed by the source, or follow your model’s equivalent guidance. Dispense when ready. Add no ice.
sourceLabel: Ninja Test Kitchen · Sugar Free Diet Soda Slush
note: Source checked 2026-11-16. 2–3 servings. Liquid allulose is required by this recipe and is not assumed stocked. Diet soda alone is not this recipe; do not omit its freezing aid. Prepare SodaStream concentrate at its label dilution before measuring. Tested source model FS301; check your model’s fill limits.
